item.title: Reading DSec section by section: what a 3-million-sandbox-a-day platform says about agent training
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the contribution is not another sandbox runtime. It is a measurement of what agent-training sandboxes actually look like — requests arrive in tens of thousands, CPU usage sits at 5% of what was requested, state lives for minutes to hours, and images are barely reused. Once all four hold, the platform cannot be a container runtime; it has to be an elastic execution platform.

item.title: Think Before You Act: How JevAct Gates LLM Agent Actions
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 This English page stays available at its own URL. The Chinese version is the one maintained first. English readers land here directly. To pin English after switching languages, use ?lang=en on this URL, e.g. this link. An agent’s action should pass through a gate that can check, compute, and send back before anything executes. JevAct splits that gate in two. code settles what tool records decide, a decision model answers only “what did the conversation actually say”, and a boolean rule combines them.
